acceptance.failure: Any unavailable view, visual route edge without verified distributed correspondence, or anchor return above 3 px ends the run. Each anchor return is sent at most once; no preset, fine correction, retry or unplanned movement is allowed.
acceptance.success: Four quiet views demonstrate baseline-to-pan, baseline-to-tilt and tilt-to-pan visual connections, each with overlap at least 0.25 and displacement at least 2 px. Both absolute returns match the baseline within 3 px.

hypothesis: A two-band, three-edge local coverage route can be observed from the main stream while AbsoluteMove returns to the anchor are visually verified, without creating a preset.
